_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Running Broc Data Lab Irish benchmarks…

description: Quantifies three classic everyday Irish money leaks calibrated to 2026 PAYE/USC/4.2% PRSI & 33% DIRT: (1) Irish Bank Inertia Tax (AIB/BOI/PTSB demand deposits vs EU high-yield banks, Money Market Funds & 100% DIRT-free NTMA State Savings — savings.datalab.broc.fi), (2) Takeaway Coffee pre-tax salary cost & 10-yr Pension AVC compounding (coffee.datalab.broc.fi), and (3) Office Lunch salary-calibrated daily budget & 0–5 day packed-lunch savings ladder (lunch.datalab.broc.fi).

boughtLunchCostEur.description: Average bought office lunch cost in EUR (default €11.50).

coffeeDaysPerWeek.description: Days per week buying takeaway coffee (default 5).

coffeePriceEur.description: Takeaway coffee price per cup in EUR (default €4.30 Dublin flat white).

grossAnnualSalaryEur.description: Gross annual Irish salary in EUR for pre-tax coffee & lunch calculations (default €52,000).

horizonYears.description: Compounding horizon in years for savings comparison (default 5).

officeDaysPerWeek.description: Days in the office per week for lunch budgeting (default 4).

packedDaysPerWeek.description: Days per week bringing a packed lunch (default 2).

packedLunchCostEur.description: Average home-packed lunch cost in EUR (default €3.00).

savingsBalanceEur.description: Cash sitting in savings in EUR for Bank Inertia Tax (default €35,000).

name: calculate_everyday_wealth_leaks
title: Irish Bank Inertia, Coffee & Office Lunch Calculator (Broc Data Lab)
